name: RunCamManagerLib
description: Professional UART driver for RunCam cameras on ESP32 / ESP32-S3 (Arduino / PlatformIO). Implements the complete RunCam Device Protocol with CRC-8/DVB-S2 (Get Device Info, Camera Control, 5-key OSD with connection management, FC attitude 0x50) plus the full MSP DisplayPort text overlay (heartbeat, release, clear, write-string, draw, options). Hardware parameters are configured via begin(); every fallible call returns a RunCamManagerStatus value. Deterministic, fault-tolerant, JSF-AV-C++ style.
